column8: The problem: rising damp with salt efflorescence (salitre) at the base of the wall: a white powdery crust and blistered, flaking paint up to about 60 cm above the floor, with a darker damp band above the baseboard. A wooden chair has been moved away from the wall.
Variant: two-storey house; the solid wooden front door, its steps and a small tree sit in the left half of the frame; the right half continues the facade with a black steel window.
